text:
maria: heads up — we've been seeing the telemetry exporter flip to OTLP/HTTP after transient gRPC errors and that cascade of retries is amplifying load on the collector. noticed spiky queue latencies and duplicate spans in traces. anyone seen this pattern before?

devin: can you paste the exporter config? collector vs SDK?

maria: collector config for the route attached below. we're using the otlp exporter with the gRPC endpoint first, HTTP fallback enabled.

```yaml
exporters:
  otlp/grpc:
    endpoint: otlp-collector.redwood.internal:4317
    timeout: 10s
  otlp/http:
    endpoint: https://otlp-collector.redwood.internal/v1/traces
    timeout: 15s
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      exporters: [otlp/grpc, otlp/http]
retry_on_failure:
  enabled: true
  initial_interval: 5s
  max_interval: 60s
  max_elapsed_time: 300s
```

maria: logs show gRPC errors like "UNAVAILABLE" and then immediate HTTP POSTs causing bursty traffic.

sam: two quick thoughts: 1) add jitter to your backoff and cap retry concurrency per-tenant, 2) make the HTTP fallback path conservatively rate-limited and mark it as non-retriable for certain status codes.

lee: disagree with marking HTTP non-retriable across the board — some transient 5xx are safe to retry if idempotency is guaranteed. do we have idempotency keys on spans?

maria: we don't today. SDKs don't attach x-idempotency-key. spans aren't perfectly idempotent so we saw duplicates in traces when client retried.

devin: proposal: 1) make gRPC have a slightly longer deadline (15s) and more forgiving backoff with jitter; 2) when gRPC hits UNAVAILABLE, do exponential backoff with randomized jitter before switching to HTTP, not immediate fallback; 3) introduce a per-exporter retry budget (token-bucket) so a bad tenant can't exhaust collector resources.

sam: yep plus add a short circuit-breaker state on the gRPC exporter in the collector: if consecutive failures > N within M seconds, mark as "degraded" and throttle requests to that exporter while background re-checks happen.

maria: drafted a small change locally. snippet:

```yaml
retry_on_failure:
  enabled: true
  initial_interval: 2s
  max_interval: 30s
  max_elapsed_time: 120s
  include_status_codes: ["Unavailable", "ResourceExhausted"]
  jitter: 0.25
fallback_policy:
  switch_after: 3 # attempts
  cooldown: 45s
```

maria: also going to add x-exporter-retry-id header from SDK so dedupe is possible downstream — helps with double-send analysis.

lee: for the per-tenant budget, can we gate on API key? we already have tenant in the x-api-key header so token-bucket per-key seems doable. but need guardrails for default customers so one noisy user doesn't blow shared buffer.

devin: operationally, we should surface this in console: per-route retry budget consumption, circuit-breaker state, and last-failure reasons. that way SRE can triage noisy tenants quickly.

ops-bot: deploy Canary: telemetry-collector v2.14.3 -> routing pool A at 11:12am (canary 10%).

maria: I ran a local canary with smaller batch_size (200 -> 50) and lowered send_timeout to 8s. latency improved but we had slightly higher total requests. trade-off noted.

sam: lower batch sizes reduce head-of-line blocking and avoid long stalls on one retry, but increases requests — which is okay if retry budget and rate limits are working.

lee: action items?

maria: I'll open a PR to:
- add jittered backoff + lower max_elapsed_time for exporter retries
- implement fallback cooldown (switch_after/cooldown) in collector exporter manager
- emit x-exporter-retry-id header from SDKs for dedupe
- add per-tenant token-bucket in collector and dashboard panels for budget usage

devin: I'll add runbook entry and console panels (retry_budget, cb_state, export_errors) — tag me when PR is up.

lee: can we also add a small e2e test that simulates transient UNAVAILABLE and verifies no immediate HTTP fallback? CI catch regressions.

maria: yes, adding e2e + unit for fallback logic.

ops-bot: note: rolling back canary if collector error rate > 5% in 5m window.

sam: +1, thanks. going to schedule a short sync if anyone wants to pair on the collector change tomorrow. :calendar: 

maria: thanks all — will post PR link here and add a short summary for release notes. :thumbsup:
